title.en: Tell strict from slack and numerical from literal inequalities

say.en: You have 200 rupees and books cost 40 rupees each. You need not spend all of it, you just cannot spend more. That is an inequality. In this lesson: Read the symbols <, >, is less than or equal to, is greater than or equal to.
Tell strict from slack and numerical from literal inequalities.
Write word statements as inequalities.

body.en: Two real numbers or expressions joined by $<$, $>$, $\le$ or $\ge$ form an *inequality*. $3 < 5$ is numerical; $x < 5$ and $ax + b > 0$ are literal. $<$ and $>$ give strict inequalities; $\le$ and $\ge$ give slack ones. $ax + b < 0$ ($a \ne 0$) is a linear inequality in one variable; $ax + by < c$ is linear in two variables; $ax^2 + bx + c > 0$ is quadratic.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಉಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು <, >, ≤, ≥ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಸಮತೆ. < ಮತ್ತು > ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಿನ ಅಸಮತೆಗಳು; ≤ ಮತ್ತು ≥ ಸಡಿಲ ಅಸಮತೆಗಳು.

narration.en: An inequality joins two expressions with less than, greater than, at most or at least. Less than and greater than are strict; at most and at least are slack.

problem.en: Rajeev has ₹200 and buys x rice packets at ₹30 each. Write the inequality.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Rajeev has ₹200 and buys x rice packets at ₹30 each. Write the inequality.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Rajeev has 200 rupees and buys x rice packets at 30 rupees each. Write the inequality.
Amount spent equals 30x.
It cannot exceed 200 rupees.
So the answer is 30x is less than or equal to 200.

problem.en: A ride allows only children shorter than 140 cm and older than 6 years. Write inequalities for height h and age a.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A ride allows only children shorter than 140 cm and older than 6 years. Write inequalities for height h and age a.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A ride allows only children shorter than 140 centimetres and older than 6 years. Write inequalities for height h and age a.
"Shorter than 140 centimetres": h is less than 140.
"Older than 6 years": a is greater than 6.
So the answer is h is less than 140 and a is greater than 6.
